title: Shifting Letters
description: You are given a lowercase string `s` and an integer array `shifts` of the same length. Shifting a letter moves it forward in the English alphabet cyclically (`'z'` wraps to `'a'`). For each `i` from `0` to `n - 1`, shift the first `i + 1` letters of `s` by `shifts[i]` positions. Return the final string after all shifts are applied.
hints: Character s[i] is shifted by the suffix sum shifts[i] + shifts[i + 1] + ... + shifts[n - 1].
Traverse from right to left accumulating the suffix sum modulo 26.
